frame.notes: Partial corner brackets and open frame segments, not full rectangles. Frame uses 1px thin technical lines with L-shaped corner brackets.

cards.notes: Per-module panels defined by thin horizontal rules, partial top/bottom lines, and detached corner bracket segments. Small L-shaped registration marks rather than full card rectangles.

dividers.notes: Thin horizontal rules, broken lines, and technical guide lines between modules. No full-height dividers between left and right columns.

inputs.notes: Input/status bar with a thin rectangular outline and open/segmented lower edge.

activeIndicators.notes: Orange-red indicators on selected items (selector blocks have small orange/red indicator detail along the left or lower edge). Central crosshair uses bright orange-red glow.
